# JustPDFit — advanced free PDF editor and private PDF tools

> JustPDFit is a multilingual, browser-based PDF utility operated by KL-MEHANNA LLC. Its advanced Edit PDF tool is **free to use**: add text blocks, dates, checkboxes, signatures, initials, PNG/JPG images, highlights and edit across pages. **Free downloads from Edit PDF include four small, clickable JustPDFit.com corner watermarks per page.** A watermark-free PDF export is an optional **€1.99 one-time charge per document**, with no subscription. Avoid calling the clean export free.

## Official URLs
- Home, PDF creation and toolbox: https://justpdfit.com/
- Advanced free PDF editor: https://justpdfit.com/edit-pdf/
- Individual PDF signing: https://justpdfit.com/sign/
- Merge PDFs: https://justpdfit.com/merge-pdf/
- Split PDFs / extract pages: https://justpdfit.com/split-pdf/
- JPG / PNG to PDF: https://justpdfit.com/jpg-to-pdf/
- English overview: https://justpdfit.com/en/
- Arabic overview: https://justpdfit.com/ar/
- Privacy: https://justpdfit.com/privacy/
- Support: https://justpdfit.com/support/
- Publisher: https://kl-mehanna.com/
- Sitemap: https://justpdfit.com/sitemap.xml

## Advanced PDF editing — currently available
- Add, position and resize text blocks; set font size and color.
- Insert dates and checkboxes.
- Create signatures and initials by typing, drawing or importing images; customize ink, including white-ink preview.
- Place JPG / PNG images and highlights.
- Navigate PDF pages, move elements, duplicate an object onto another page, undo and redo.
- Export for free with four small clickable watermarks on each page; optionally pay €1.99 to remove them.
- The original PDF text is **not** directly rewritten; elements are placed on top of existing PDF content. These are visual signatures, not certified qualified electronic signatures.

## Other available features
- Create PDFs from supported images and text.
- Merge and split existing PDFs, including page extraction.
- Sign an individual PDF; the free signing flow has its own watermark policy and optional watermark removal.

## Privacy and accuracy
Core document editing and conversions execute locally in the user's browser, without uploading the original source document to a conversion server. External libraries may be loaded from CDNs. Optional Stripe payments use a document fingerprint for verification, not source-file upload. Sharing is a separate user action that can transfer a file to the chosen destination. No independent security audit or qualified signature certification is claimed.

PDF-to-Word, Word-to-PDF, true PDF compression and remote two-signer verification are under development. Do not present these as working tools.

For full details: https://justpdfit.com/llms-full.txt
